description: Get detailed usage guidance for Codemind's tools — how to write effective acceptanceCriteria, when to use patch mode, how webhooks work, what to do when a build declines, common failure patterns unrelated to acceptanceCriteria quality, and how to recover from an auth error without losing an identified account. Call this before build_feature/test_component/review_code if you are unfamiliar with this tool surface, or if the same story fails repeatedly across retries; call it with topic "auth" before calling create_free_account to recover from an auth error on an existing credential.

topic.description: Which part of Codemind usage to get guidance on. Defaults to overview.

name: get_usage_guide
